title: Workflow
description: A process modeled as a deterministic state machine of Tasks and Gates (WF-001..024).

apiVersion.description: API version of this workflow definition.

dslVersion.description: Workflow DSL version in major.minor form. Omit to use the current supported version.

metadata.description: Identity and optional labels or annotations for this workflow.

spec.description: The workflow's triggers, run controls, and deterministic state-machine definition.

gaggle.description: Name of the gaggle this workflow belongs to.

displayName.description: Human-facing workflow name shown in the portal.

triggers.description: Conditions that may start a run once readiness checks also pass. A manual trigger must be the only trigger.

readiness.description: Admission limits that bound when runs may start. maxChainDepth is reserved and is not currently enforced.

maxConcurrentRuns.description: Maximum simultaneous runs of this workflow.

maxRunsPerHour.description: Rolling hourly run budget. Zero or omitted both fall back to the scheduler default of 10 — NOT unlimited (that is instance.yaml's runConditions.maxParallelRuns, where zero does mean unlimited). Set an explicit large value if you want a high hourly ceiling.

maxRunsPerDay.description: Rolling 24-hour run budget. Zero or omitted disables the daily cap.

maxChainDepth.description: Reserved maximum depth for signal-triggered workflow chains. The scheduler does not currently enforce this field, and configuring it has no effect.

maxOpenPRs.description: Maximum open pull requests produced by this workflow. Zero or omitted disables the cap.

runControls.description: Workflow-level overrides for inherited runner safety budgets.

outboxMirrorPath.description: Absolute local filesystem root (or ~/ path) where durable journal outbox files are additionally mirrored. Tasks may override it.

start.description: Name of the first task, gate, or parallel state.

docsRoots.description: In-repo documentation roots this workflow keeps current (docs-updater, #472/#1016). Ordered repo-relative paths (files or directories); the run's writes are confined to these roots. Each must be non-empty and must not escape the repository.

tutorScope.description: Declares this workflow as a Tutor-role definition and its topology tier (TUT-A4): per-workflow (confined to target's own subtree) or per-gaggle (the gaggle's shared config).

tier.description: Tutor topology tier: confined to one workflow or shared across its gaggle.

target.description: Workflow name a per-workflow tutor is confined to. Omit for a per-gaggle tutor.

requires.description: Provider-capability requirements this workflow needs from its gaggle's connected provider (CONF-6, #2079). Distinct from a task's requiredCapabilities (runner/toolchain) and capabilities (credential grants). Omit to derive the requirement set from the stages this workflow uses; an explicit value here replaces that derivation entirely.

capabilities.description: Provider capability keys this workflow requires (e.g. "pr.merge", "pr.landing.enqueue") — see docs/design/provider-contract-conformance.md §3.1.

tasks.description: Work states in the workflow state machine.

gates.description: Validation and branching states in the workflow state machine.

parallels.description: Static fan-out/fan-in states in the workflow state machine.

name.description: Branch identifier used in journal events, completeness records, and branch-qualified input references.

start.description: Name of this branch's first task or gate.

parallel.description: A fan-out/fan-in state: forks the run into a statically-declared set of named branches and joins them at a single successor once every branch has settled. failurePolicy is required — there is no default. onFailure is required for fail_fast/all_or_nothing and forbidden under continue_on_error, where the join always runs and owns the decision.

name.description: State name used as a transition target.

failurePolicy.description: How branch failures affect sibling branches, the join state, and failure routing.

branches.description: Statically declared branches, assigned deterministic branch IDs in declaration order.

join.description: State run once after all branches settle when the failure policy permits joining.

onFailure.description: State or reserved terminal target used when fail_fast or all_or_nothing observes a branch failure.

branchTimeoutSeconds.description: Declared branch budget used only for compile-time task-timeout coherence checks. The runner does not currently enforce a branch wall-clock timeout.

maxConcurrentBranches.description: Maximum number of branches dispatched concurrently. Omit or set to 1 for deterministic sequential execution. Values greater than 1 are supported only when every reachable branch stage uses a scratch or repo-readonly workspace; writable branch workspaces are rejected.

metadata.description: Deliberately left open (no additionalProperties:false) unlike the rest of this schema: k8s-style metadata objects tolerate forward-compatible extra fields (e.g. a future resourceVersion) by convention (#125).

name.description: DNS-label-compatible workflow name, unique within its gaggle.

labels.description: String labels used to organize this workflow.

annotations.description: Non-identifying string metadata attached to this workflow.

runControls.description: Runner-level safety budgets. Omitted fields inherit from gaggle then instance defaults.

maxRepasses.description: Maximum number of times gates may cumulatively route a run back to the same already-completed stage before escalation, regardless of gate or outcome.

stalledRunTimeout.description: Maximum journal-silent period before watchdog escalation, expressed as a Go duration.

maxRunDuration.description: Maximum total wall-clock age of a run, expressed as a Go duration. Omit to disable.

type.description: Trigger kind. backlog-item fans out scheduler runs from the provider's eligible-item count; webhook requires GitHub event names in events.

selector.description: For backlog-item triggers, selector keys are required labels and values are ignored.

trustLabel.description: Explicit SEC-047 approval label used to classify a directly triggered backlog item as maintainer integrity. Selector labels remain routing criteria and never imply approval.

labelPredicate.description: CEL label-set predicate using only string membership in `labels` and boolean &&, ||, and !. ANDed with selector.

fieldPredicate.description: CEL predicate over the provider's typed native-field projection. ANDed with selector; unavailable fields are errors.

priority.description: Provider polling priority. Higher values are preserved first when a quota window cannot cover every due poll.

schedule.description: Cron expression or @every interval used by a schedule trigger.

idleBackoff.description: Adaptive delay after consecutive scheduled runs find no work. Omitted defaults to enabled with a one-minute floor and fifteen-minute ceiling.

enabled.description: Enable adaptive idle backoff. Defaults to true.

floor.description: Minimum idle interval as a positive Go duration. Defaults to 1m.

ceiling.description: Maximum idle interval as a positive Go duration. Defaults to 15m and must not be below floor.

signal.description: External signal name used by a signal trigger.

events.description: GitHub webhook event names accepted by a webhook trigger, such as pull_request, issues, or check_suite.

name.description: State name, unique within this workflow.

type.description: Execution kind: deterministic runs declared code; agentic invokes a goober.

goal.description: Intended outcome supplied to the stage invocation.

goober.description: Goober definition invoked by an agentic task. Forbidden for deterministic tasks.

run.description: Host command or script executed by a deterministic task. Forbidden for agentic tasks.

command.description: Executable followed by its arguments, invoked without shell interpretation.

script.description: Inline script executed by the host's native command interpreter. Mutually exclusive with command.

env.description: Explicit environment variables added to the runner's minimal environment and scoped credentials.

network.description: Network policy for the command. Set to none to deny network access.

workspace.description: Workspace provisioned for the command: writable repository, empty scratch directory, or detached read-only repository.

syncBase.description: Whether to merge the freshly fetched base ref into an existing run branch before execution. Valid only for a writable repository workspace.

workspace.description: Workspace provisioned for an agentic task. Deterministic tasks use run.workspace instead.

outbox.description: Workspace-relative paths (files or directories) this stage durably exports into the run journal's outbox namespace on completion, for output that isn't something that can PR against a repo. A declared path that is missing is skipped; one that escapes the workspace fails the stage closed.

outboxMirrorPath.description: Task-level override for the local outbox mirror root. Most specific value wins over workflow and gaggle settings.

inputs.description: Static task-specific values merged into the invocation envelope's inputs.

inputsFrom.description: Explicit input-key to preceding-output-key mappings for task-to-task scalar handoff.

capabilities.description: Credential capability grants available to this task. Agentic grants must be a subset of the referenced goober's grants.

minimumIntegrity.description: Lowest provenance grade this task accepts from its backlog item and context pointers.

contextFrom.description: Workflow task or gate names whose artifacts and verdicts are routed into this task's context. Omitted means all accumulated context pointers.

policyActions.description: Closed vocabulary of externally mutating actions this task may perform because policy, persona, or verdict output prescribes them. Agentic tasks must include every unconditional action declared by their referenced goober, and compiler admission requires each action's canonical capability.

nestedAgentPolicy.description: Versioned policy governing delegated children of this agentic task.

maxDepth.description: Maximum additional delegation depth for bounded authority.

permittedProfiles.description: Agent profiles a child may select.

context.description: Whether and which task context is selected for the child.

artifactNames.description: Selected artifact handles for explicit context.

envelopeSections.description: Selected execution-envelope sections for explicit context.

maxReasoningEffort.description: Highest reasoning effort a child may request.

peerMessaging.description: Whether the child may message peer agents.

platformPolicy.description: Immutable platform restrictions inherited by every child.

capabilities.description: Capability ceiling inherited from the parent.

credentials.description: Credential grants inherited from the parent.

sandbox.description: Sandbox posture inherited from the parent.

filesystemRoots.description: Writable/readable filesystem roots inherited from the parent.

networkEgress.description: Permitted network egress inherited from the parent.

contentExclusions.description: Content exclusions inherited from the parent.

cancellation.description: Cancellation channel inherited from the parent.

completionContract.description: Completion contract inherited from the parent.

requiredCapabilities.description: Runner (toolchain/platform) capabilities this stage needs, matched at schedule time against a runner's advertised set (RRQ-1/#1101) — distinct from credential capabilities above.

retry.description: Deterministic retry policy for failed stage attempts.

maxAttempts.description: Total attempts including the first; one disables retries.

backoffSeconds.description: Constant delay in seconds between attempts.

timeoutSeconds.description: Wall-clock limit for one task attempt. Omitted preserves the executor default.

limits.description: Execution and agent-usage limits for this task.

maxDurationSeconds.description: Maximum wall-clock duration. timeoutSeconds, when set, is authoritative.

maxTokens.description: Maximum model tokens this task may consume. Zero means no explicit limit.

maxCostUSD.description: Maximum model spend in US dollars. Zero means no explicit limit.

expectedOutputs.description: Intended task postconditions. Accepted for forward compatibility but not enforced by the local runner.

continueOnError.description: Whether this stage's failure is tolerated. With a task as `next`, a failed stage fails the run unless this is true. With a gate as `next`, the failed status always reaches the gate and its branches are honored either way; this flag then only decides how a failure the gate routes to workflow completion is recorded — tolerated (run completes) or preserved (run marked failed). Failed-task outputs are discarded in every case.

onTimeout.description: Agentic timeout behavior: fail the attempt or salvage a viable committed diff.

next.description: Next task, gate, or parallel state. Empty means successful terminal completion.

name.description: State name, unique within this workflow.

evaluator.description: Evaluator kind configured by exactly one of automated, agentic, or human.

automated.description: Configuration for a deterministic built-in check. Set only when evaluator is automated.

check.description: Registered automated check name. Built-in names are status-equals, failure-class, output-equals, output-not-equals, output-numeric-gte, output-numeric-lte, output-numeric-lt, output-matches, ci-status, land-outcome, and queue-outcome.

params.description: Check parameters. Output equality checks use key+equals; numeric checks use key+threshold; output-matches uses key+pattern (RE2).

timeoutSeconds.description: Wall-clock limit for one automated evaluator attempt.

retry.description: Retry policy for failed automated evaluator attempts.

maxAttempts.description: Total evaluator attempts including the first; one disables retries.

backoffSeconds.description: Constant delay in seconds between evaluator attempts.

pollIntervalSeconds.description: Polling cadence for remote checks such as ci-status.

agentic.description: Configuration for a reviewer goober. Set only when evaluator is agentic.

goober.description: Reviewer goober that returns the gate verdict.

timeoutSeconds.description: Wall-clock limit for one reviewer attempt.

workspace.description: Workspace provisioned for the reviewer. Omitted preserves the writable repository default.

retry.description: Retry policy for failed reviewer attempts.

maxAttempts.description: Total reviewer attempts including the first; one disables retries.

backoffSeconds.description: Constant delay in seconds between reviewer attempts.

human.description: Configuration for an explicit human decision. Set only when evaluator is human.

approvers.description: Optional identities or groups allowed to approve the gate.

timeoutSeconds.description: Reserved human-decision timeout. Only zero or omission is currently supported; nonzero values are rejected and the runner waits for an explicit decision.

onTimeout.description: Reserved timeout action. Human timeout behavior is not currently supported, so configuring this field is rejected.

maxRepasses.description: Override of the inherited target-stage re-entry budget when this gate routes to an already-completed stage; valid for automated and agentic gates.

branches.description: Outcome-to-next-state mapping. The pass key is the success branch; escalate may route forced escalation.
